verdict.rationale: Floot is an app-building platform, so official SDKs are a fair question, but the evidence shows no SDK of any kind. The manifest states the remote MCP server is Floot's only programmatic surface, and probes found no OpenAPI document or REST API. An MCP endpoint is a different integration surface, not an official SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
